verdict.rationale: Fellow publishes a structured Developer API reference with per-endpoint pages (recordings, action items, note editing, webhooks) suggesting a ReadMe.io-style docs site, but there is no confirmed evidence of a live 'try it' interactive console or runnable code examples — the openapi.json/swagger.json probe returned 404 across all candidate paths, indicating no public machine-readable spec to power an interactive explorer. missing for 10: explicit runnable 'try it' console evidence, public OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent confirmation of interactivity.
